`final class Lwjgl3CoreGlFrameBufferBinding`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/iglframebufferbinding/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.lwjgl3.opengl` · **Module:** `base-lwjgl3-opengl` · **Source:** [Lwjgl3CoreGlFrameBufferBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/lwjgl3-opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/lwjgl3/opengl/Lwjgl3CoreGlFrameBufferBinding.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The LWJGL 3 framebuffer binding that calls the core framebuffer functions of OpenGL 3.0 and `GL_ARB_framebuffer_object`.

## Description

[`Lwjgl3GlBinding.getFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-opengl/lwjgl3glbinding/#Lwjgl3GlBinding-method-getFrameBufferBinding) returns it for the `CORE` family.
